definition.readyMs: cycle start (real clock) -> page presented through the real shelf UI, live, content+session verified, input gate interactive, activation checked
definition.wheelMs: full software wheel scenario including setup, failed main-window attempt, fallback/retry and 25ms polling -> observed movement; not hardware latency
definition.wheelDelivery: attempt order: main-window webContents.sendInputEvent -> guest webContents.sendInputEvent (two ticks) -> scroll reset + guest tick. The recorded observer counts show which delivery actually reached the page; the main-window wheel does not reach a webview guest in this build, so samples are dominated by guest-level software input
definition.excluded: no read-only scroll IPC exists in ordinary mode and none is fabricated; keyboard/IME/OS-hardware input latency is NOT claimed
